introduction.title: A more <highlight>intelligent</highlight> future, powered by $IQ.
introduction.description: BrainDAO is the legal entity that launched $IQ. It governs the token, stewards its treasury, and operates HiIQ staking.

token.title: Governance, staking, and a shared <highlight>treasury.</highlight>
token.description: $IQ is the governance token launched by BrainDAO. Holders lock IQ through HiIQ to vote on proposals, earn staking rewards, and direct the DAO's treasury. Products built on IQ live on their own platforms; BrainDAO is the entity behind the token itself.

governance.title: Governance
governance.description: HiIQ balance determines voting power on IQ proposals. Lock longer, weigh heavier in every decision the DAO makes.

staking.title: Staking rewards
staking.description: Stakers earn additional IQ, distributed proportionally to their HiIQ balance for as long as their lock is active.

burn.title: Fee burn & redistribution
burn.description: A share of ecosystem platform fees paid in IQ is burned or redistributed to stakers, putting deflationary pressure on supply.

treasury.title: A treasury governed by <highlight>IQ stakers.</highlight>
treasury.description: BrainDAO stewards the IQ ecosystem's treasury (IQ, stablecoins, and strategic assets), deployed by governance vote to fund rewards, liquidity, and growth.

chart.label: HiIQ total locked
chart.foot: ≈ {percent} of circulating supply is locked in HiIQ and earning rewards.

meta.title: HiIQ - Lock IQ for governance power and staking rewards
meta.description: HiIQ is the staking mechanism for the IQ token. Lock IQ for up to four years to increase your voting power and earn staking rewards.

hiiq.title: Lock $IQ. <highlight>Gain HiIQ.</highlight>
hiiq.description: HiIQ is the staking mechanism for $IQ. Locking IQ grants HiIQ, the balance that determines your governance voting power and your share of staking rewards.

mechanism.title: Up to 4 years. Up to <highlight>4× HiIQ.</highlight>
mechanism.description: HiIQ follows the veCRV model: lock $IQ for up to 4 years and receive up to 4× your locked amount in HiIQ. The longer the lock, the higher your HiIQ balance, and with it your voting power and reward share.

estimate.title: See what a lock <highlight>returns.</highlight>
estimate.description: Drag the lock length to see the HiIQ you would receive for 1,000 IQ, and the boost multiplier that comes with it. The same curve applies at any size.
estimate.note: Locks can be extended at any time. Extending resets the decay and restores the boost.

decay.title: HiIQ <highlight>decays</highlight> as your lock matures.
decay.description: Your HiIQ balance decreases linearly as the lock approaches expiry, reaching 1:1 with your locked IQ at zero time remaining. Extending a lock restores the boost.
decay.transfer: HiIQ is non-transferable. It does not trade on markets; it is an account-based measure of how long your IQ stays locked.

payout.title: Earn IQ, proportional to HiIQ
payout.description: Stakers earn additional IQ, distributed proportionally to HiIQ balance. A share of ecosystem platform fees may be burned or redistributed to stakers, a deflationary mechanism for $IQ.

requirements.title: What you need to stake
requirements.iq: $IQ on Ethereum, where HiIQ staking lives
requirements.gas: ETH for gas on lock, extend, and claim transactions
requirements.lock: A lock period of your choice, up to 4 years

newsletter.description: Governance updates and <iq>$IQ</iq> news, in your inbox.

about.text: BrainDAO is the governing DAO and legal entity behind the IQ token, supported by <link>BrainFund</link>. It stewards the IQ treasury and operates HiIQ staking.
